label: unstated
reason: The docstring only shows a hyphenated two-word number ("thirty-two" → "32") and never says how the connector word "and" is treated, while the reference code gives it a zero value so it is absorbed into the number. A programmer who treats "and" as an ordinary non-number word would return "100 and 23" instead of "123".
missing: The docstring should say that the connector word "and" between number words is ignored and merged into the surrounding number, so that a spoken-style number converts to a single integer string.
